clauses.title: Scope – Requirements of
clauses.text: 1.   Scope - Requirements of ferrous and non-ferrous filler rods for gas welding made of  the following materials supplied in cut lengths. a) Structural  steels, b) Austenitic stainless steels, c) Cast irons (excluding  spheroidal  graphite and malleable iron castings), d) Copper and copper alloys, e) Nickel and nickel alloys, f) Aluminium and aluminium alloys, and g) Magnesium and magnesium alloys.

clauses.title: Length – It shall
clauses.text: 2.2 Length - It shall be 500 or 1000 mm for rods less than 2.5 mm dia and 1000 mm for rods 2.5 mm and above. The tolerance on length  of cast iron filler  rods shall be 6 50 + − mm. For all other   rods shall be   ± 5 mm.

clauses.title: Shall be free from
clauses.text: 3.1 Shall be free from surface imperfections, corrosion products, grease, excessive oxide, etc.

clauses.title: Structural steel filler rods
clauses.text: 3.2 Structural steel filler rods shall have a protective copper coating; copper content not exceeding 0.4 percent by weight.

clauses.title: Aluminium, aluminium
clauses.text: 3.3 Aluminium, aluminium  alloy and magnesium alloy filler rods shall be supplied in as manufactured condition.

clauses.title: In case of austenitic
clauses.text: 3.4 In case of austenitic stainless steel filler rods, the inter - crystalline corrosion test may be conducted. The test piece shall show no sign of cracking. Note 1 -  For chemical composition requirements, refer to Tables 2 to 8 of the standard. Note 2 -  A guide for selection and use of  gas  welding rods is given in Appendix A of the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS  1278 : 1972  Specifications for  filler rods for gas  welding  (second revision).
